title: Video Test Source
text: Generate continuous video stream data, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Color space} sets Color space; {Frame size} sets the frame dimensions, {Video source} selects video source type, {Input file name} selects input video, {Reorder output frame} sets the output frame reordering and {Frame sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Video source
params.values: Select video source type Video file (default) | Color bar | Ramp

params.name: Input file name
params.values: Select input video file handshake_left.avi (default) | any supported video file format
